data.productNameEn: Pet Dog Cat Ice Silk Cold Nest Pad For Cooling In Summer
data.categoryName: Pet Supplies > Pet Bedding > Pet Mats
data.description:
Overview:
1. Cool, comfortable, durable and pet-friendly
2. Provide instant cooling effect
3. Suitable for pets of all sizes
4. Use this simple and effective pet cooling pad to help your pet withstand the unbearable high temperature! Unlike most cooling pads that rely on water and cooling, this specially designed cooling pad uses heat-resistant fibers to make your pet immune to heat!

Product information:
Name: Pet dog cooling pad
Fabric decomposition: cold ice silk on the surface, cotton in the middle, breathable mesh on the back
Features: exquisite embroidery/fine routing
Color: ice silk cushion blue, ice silk cushion pink
Size: S: 50*40cm, M: 63*50cm, L: 70*56cm, XL: 102*70cm
Weight: S/100g, M/150g, L/200g, XL/320g

Notes:
Manual measurement for different batches, error range 2-3cm, weight 10-20g

Package Contents:
Cushion*1
